profile.title: My Profile
profile.subtitle: Manage your personal settings and notification preferences.

notification_preferences.title: My Notification Preferences
notification_preferences.description: Mute specific notifications that you don't want to receive. If unchecked, the organization default routing will be used.

organization.title: Organization Profile
organization.subtitle: Manage your company details, data protection officer, and branding.

dpo.title: Data Protection Officer
dpo.dpo_hint: Under GDPR, a DPO is required if you regularly process personal data on a large scale or process special category data.
dpo.name: DPO Name

team.title: Team Management
team.subtitle: Manage organization members, roles, and granular access permissions.

permissions.title: Edit Permissions
permissions.owner_warning: Owner permissions cannot be restricted. They have full access to all modules.
permissions.description: Override role-based access for specific modules. Green check grants access, red cross denies, gray dash inherits from role.
permissions.footer: Changes save automatically and will invalidate the user's current session to enforce new permissions.

notifications.title: Platform Settings
notifications.subtitle: Manage integrations and global notification routing.

slack_integration.title: Slack Integration
slack_integration.subtitle: Route alerts to a channel
slack_integration.webhook_hint: Create an Incoming Webhook in your Slack workspace settings and paste the URL here to enable Slack notifications.

routing.title: Notification Routing
routing.admin_note_text: The checkboxes control the organization-wide defaults. Individual team members can click the bell icon next to a channel to mute it for themselves personally.

policy.out_of_sync: Policy out of sync with ROPA

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Connect CRM and marketing tools for automated DSAR discovery.
integrations.disconnect_warning: Disconnecting will disable automatic DSAR data discovery. Any in-progress DSAR searches will be marked as manual. Proceed?

developers.title: Developers
developers.subtitle: Manage API keys and Webhooks for external integrations

api_keys.title: API Keys
api_keys.revoke_description: This will instantly disable the key. Any applications using it will lose access.

modal.title: Create API Key
modal.name: Name
modal.warning: This key will only be shown once. Copy it now and store it securely.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.delete_description: This will permanently delete the webhook and stop sending events.

billing.title: Billing & Subscriptions
billing.subtitle: Manage your plan and payment methods.

locked.trial_ended_desc: Subscribe to keep access to your compliance data.
locked.payment_failed_desc: Update your billing details to restore access to your account.
locked.canceled_desc: Resubscribe to restore access to your account.

professional.name: Professional
professional.description: The complete OS for growing agencies.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: For large organizations needing custom compliance controls.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage your password, MFA, and active sessions.

mfa.title: Multi-factor Authentication (MFA)
mfa.scan_qr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password).

disable_confirm.title: Disable MFA?
disable_confirm.description: Are you sure you want to disable MFA? This decreases account security.

revoke_all_confirm.title: Revoke all other sessions?
revoke_all_confirm.description: This will log out all other devices.

data.title: Data & Privacy
data.subtitle: Export your organization's data or delete your account.

export.title: Export Data
export.description: You can request a complete export of your organization's data. This includes all processing activities, vendor assessments, DSAR records, breaches, and uploaded documents.
export.email_notice: A zip file will be sent to your email when ready.
export.success: Export requested successfully! You will receive an email when it is ready.
export.error: Failed to request data export. Please try again later.

retention.title: Data Retention Policy
retention.active: retained as long as your account is active
retention.consent: retained for 5 years after collection (regulatory requirement)
retention.audit: retained for 3 years after the event
retention.deleted: permanently removed 30 days after deletion request

deletion.title: Danger Zone
deletion.description: Permanently delete this organization and all of its data. This action cannot be undone. Data will be hard-deleted after a 30-day grace period.
deletion.error: Failed to schedule organization for deletion.
deletion.confirm_description: This permanently deletes all data after a 30-day grace period.
